text:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up: some folks adding international dependents this morning hit a "missing SSN/ITIN" validation and their enrollment is in HOLD. If you see HOLD in the portal, please read below and follow the steps. cc @Sanjay @Marta

Sanjay (Benefits): We pushed a client-side change that tightened SSN validation for API parity with the insurer. Problem: many international dependents don't have an SSN/ITIN yet so enrollments moved to HOLD instead of processing. We're flagging these for manual review.

Liam (Eng): i'm one of the affected folks - my partner is on a dependent visa and doesn't have SSN yet. Portal shows "hold: missing id". Will this block coverage start? i added them yesterday.

Marta (Payroll): Payroll won't create deductions until Benefits confirms active enrollment. If Benefits approves manually, payroll can backdate deductions to the plan effective date. For tax-affected items (pre-tax HSA), absent SSN/ITIN may complicate retro-adjustments; we'll work case-by-case.

Sanjay (Benefits): For dependents without SSN/ITIN we can accept alternative proof (passport + visa stamp + dependent birth certificate if applicable) and manually mark the enrollment as accepted with a note. We need the documents uploaded to the secure docs uploader by 2028-12-08 23:59 PT to be considered "on time." That's our temporary window for affected cases.

Ava (People Ops): Decision: People Ops is granting a narrow extension for enrollments stuck in HOLD between 2028-12-05 08:00 UTC and 2028-12-05 18:00 UTC. Qualifying employees must: 1) have portal status HOLD, AND 2) upload alternative ID docs to the secure uploader by the deadline. We'll send a banner and targeted DMs.

Liam (Eng): what exact docs are acceptable? i can upload passport + visa. do you need translation for non-english docs?

Sanjay (Benefits): Acceptable: passport + visa entry stamp, dependent visa page, marriage certificate for spouses, or birth certificate for kids. If docs are not in English, we need a simple certified translation (scanned). Scans must be PDF/JPG, <=10MB. Mention your original attempt timestamp in the upload notes.

Ava (People Ops): Upload instructions: https://benefits.redwood.com -> My Docs -> Secure Upload. Template for the note: 
``
Name: Liam Eng
Event: Add dependent (partner)
Original submit TS: 2028-12-05 10:12 UTC
Portal status: HOLD (missing SSN)
Docs: passport_visa.pdf
```
If you cannot access the portal, email benefits@redwood-secure.com with subject "HOLD_UPLOAD: <your-name>" and attach docs.

Marta (Payroll): Timeline: benefits manual review completes by Monday. If approved, payroll will apply retro deductions on the next payroll run. We'll post a reconciliation summary in #payroll once complete. If there are tax concerns for HSA retro changes we'll reach out to the impacted employee personally.

HR Bot: automated DM will ping anyone flagged with HOLD to remind them to upload docs by the deadline.

Ava (People Ops): we'll notify managers and include an FAQ entry: "What if I don't have SSN yet?" -> Use alternative docs, enroll will be processed manually; don't assume denial. If there are special cases (visa dependent with pending SSN issuance), DM me and we'll loop Legal. Closing for now; ping if you need help. :raised_hands:
